title: Toot, Toot, Tootsie
writers: Gus Kahn, Ernie Erdman and Dan Russo

evidence.note: Wikipedia states the song, written by Gus Kahn, Ernie Erdman and Dan Russo, was published in 1922 by Leo Feist, Inc.
IMSLP catalog lists the original sheet music as 'New York: Leo Feist, 1922,' crediting Gus Kahn, Ernie Erdman and Dan Russo, confirming the 1922 publication year.

famous_use: Sung by Al Jolson in The Jazz Singer (1927), one of the first major talking pictures.
